name: RoleFit Studio
tagline: AI-native ATS resume & job-match studio: skill-gap scoring, live company intel, and grounded XYZ bullet tailoring.
description:
RoleFit Studio pairs a deterministic ATS skill-gap & XYZ-bullet diagnostic engine with Anna AI OS's Host LLM, live Web Search, and Persistent Storage so job seekers can tailor every application with zero API keys and zero hallucinated credentials.

**Key Capabilities**

- **Weighted ATS Match Scoring (0-100)**: Evaluates Hard Skills (45%), Must-Have vs Preferred JD Alignment (25%), Google XYZ Bullet Impact & Quantification (20%), and ATS Section/Seniority Readiness (10%).
- **Evidence-Grounded XYZ Bullet Diffs**: Uses `anna.llm.complete` to upgrade passive or unquantified bullets into crisp XYZ-formula statements using explicit `[X%]` metric slots instead of inventing fake numbers, with 1-click Apply & instant re-scoring.
- **Live Job URL Fetch & Company Intelligence**: Pulls live job postings via `anna.web.fetch` and researches product momentum, engineering culture, and smart reverse-interview questions via `anna.web.search`.
- **Hiring Manager Outreach & Interview Prep**: Drafts concise `<110-word` cold DMs, cover hooks, and role-specific interview questions anchored to your real resume stories.
- **Durable Application Tracker & ATS-Safe Export**: Saves your master resume and tailored role snapshots via Anna Persistent Storage (`anna.storage.*`), posts scorecard cards into Anna Chat (`anna.chat.append_artifact`), and exports parser-safe Markdown or plain text.
